messages:
deploy-bot: config-deploy finished for branch=feature/routing-schema. Deployed routing policy schema v2 -> cluster-config. Commit: d4f7a1e.

ops-bot: healthcheck: deployment succeeded. no errors in smoke tests.

sylvia (oncall): seeing a spike in 5xx from routing service in eu-west-1, starting ~1923457000. Alerting paged. @ben @kai can you take a look? :eyes:

pagerduty: PagerDuty event: HIGH - RoutingPolicyService errors in eu-west-1 -> paging sylvia (oncall). Incident ID: PD-8672.

sylvia (oncall): acknowledging PD-8672. I'm on it, will collect logs.

ben (eng-runtime): joining. I see a flood of 503s and circuit-breaker tripping on model-pool selection. Traces show repeated attempts: eu-west-1 -> us-central-1 -> eu-west-1 -> us-central-1 (loop).

kai (eng-platform): hmm, that looks like a fallback loop. The new schema removed the deprecated field `prefer_region` and defaulted to global fallback behavior. Could be default mismatch between control plane and runtime.

samira (product): any customer impact yet? Support queue showing 3 tickets about slow responses from app X.

support-queue-bot: 3 new tickets tagged #latency from customer: finlytics, startup-alpha, docs-search.

ben (eng-runtime): pulling routing policy for customer finlytics. Policy in control plane now looks like: ```json
{"routing_version":"v2","fallback_policy":"allow_global","variants":[{"model":"redwood-llama-13b-q4","region":"eu-west-1"}],"deprecated_prefer_local":null}
```

ben (eng-runtime): runtime expected `deprecated_prefer_local=true` for this cluster in previous schema which prevented global fallback. Now null -> runtime treats as false -> global fallback enabled -> sudden cross-region bursts and oscillation as capacity constraints bounce requests between regions.

kai (eng-platform): confirmed mismatch: control plane validated against new schema but some runtimes still using older code path that interprets missing field differently. The earlier implicit behavior was "prefer_local if present or assumed true". New default breaks that.

sylvia (oncall): immediate mitigation options? Can we temporarily set a runtime override to force prefer_local=true on the cluster?

ben (eng-runtime): yes. I can push a runtime override via /admin/config override: `routing.override.prefer_local=true` to the agent -- will apply immediately to active runtimes.

kai (eng-platform): I'll prepare the change. Ben, do it with a 10m TTL and monitor. I'm ready to rollback control-plane if needed.

ben (eng-runtime): running: ```bash
curl -X POST "https://admin.internal/routing/override" -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" -d '{"cluster":"eu-west-1","routing.override.prefer_local":true,"ttl_seconds":600}'
```

ben (eng-runtime): override applied. Runtime reports: `override active: routing.override.prefer_local=true (expires in 600s)`. Error rate dropping in eu-west-1.

ops-bot: metric update: 5xx rate in eu-west-1 decreased from 4.2% -> 0.6% over 90s after override. Latency p50 also returned to baseline.

sylvia (oncall): marking as mitigated. PagerDuty: add note that temporary runtime override applied; monitoring.

pagerduty: PD-8672 note added: runtime override applied to force prefer_local=true; awaiting config rollback.

samira (product): good. Can we also confirm wrong model variant selection? Support mentioned hallucination-like outputs for docs-search.

ben (eng-runtime): logs show some requests routed to redwood-llama-30b-unquantized in us-central as fallback, which increased token usage and cost and produced unexpected verboseness. That was because fallback allowed any variant with higher capacity instead of the intended smaller quantized variant. The v2 schema defaulted fallback to broad candidate set.

kai (eng-platform): we have two workstreams: short (runtime override + control plane rollback) and medium (add explicit compatibility flag and update runtimes to interpret missing fields consistently). I'll coordinate the rollback.

ben (eng-runtime): initiating rollback of control-plane policy schema change. Reverting commit d4f7a1e. ```bash
git revert d4f7a1e -m 1 && ./deploy-control-plane.sh --target routing-schema
```

ops-bot: rollback deploy started for routing-schema.

support-queue-bot: customer finlytics: 12 requests/min affected, recovery visible. status updated to "mitigated".

samira (product): I'll message affected customers with a short update: root cause is a schema change that changed default routing fallback behavior; we've applied an immediate runtime override and rolled back the schema change; full postmortem to follow.

sylvia (oncall): handing off to ben for post-rollback monitoring. I'm going to sleep after 40m monitoring window. @ben please escalate if anything regresses. :wave:

ben (eng-runtime): monitoring. ops-bot shows rollback finished at 1923460100, config now restored to previous defaults. Overrides will expire and then runtime will behave as before.

ops-bot: metric update: 5xx in eu-west-1 steady at 0.2%, latency nominal. No new pager events.

kai (eng-platform): next actions for postmortem: - owner: ben - timeframe: root cause analysis + timeline - fix: add schema compatibility tests, enforce default semantics in control-plane validator, add runtime feature-flag compatibility layer - customer compensations: samira to propose comms and any credits

ben (eng-runtime): assigned postmortem owner. I'll capture logs, diffs, and propose a compatibility contract.

samira (product): adding postmortem template link: https://redwood.internal/pm/postmortems/201. Will draft customer comms.

sylvia (oncall): closing PD-8672 after confirmation from ben. Thanks all for quick response. :thumbsup:

pagerduty: PD-8672 status: RESOLVED.

ben (eng-runtime): final note: long-term we should ban silent defaults for deprecated fields. We'll add a linter rule and a runtime warning at startup when control-plane schema changes are detected.

samira (product): noted. Will include in postmortem action items.

ops-bot: incident summary (auto): PD-8672 - routing schema change inadvertently changed default fallback semantics -> cross-region fallback loops and wrong variant fallbacks -> temporary runtime override + control-plane rollback mitigated. Postmortem owner: ben.

ben (eng-runtime): filing follow-up ticket: INF-4521 - schema-default-compatability-tests + runtime-flag-compat.

sylvia (oncall): thanks everyone. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
